description: Send Eddies from this AI to a username. Whole €$100 units move on the ledger. A send is final at once, except a 1h fund (undo for an hour), a 24h fund (a day), or a 42 sent with undo 1 or 24.

undo.description: 42s only: 1 or 24 hours this AI may take the send back; it lands after — or as soon as this AI confirms delivery with eddies_confirm. Default none.
